name: legacy-null-transaction
recorded: 2026-09-12, hand-built from x402-specification-v2.md §5.3.2 (SettleResponse fields) and §9 (settlement_pending); no live door, no hostname
why: The legacy timeout shape a facilitator operator reported on the spec thread: {success:false, transaction:null} on a broadcast whose confirmation timed out. transaction is not a string, so the response cannot say whether anything moved. A reader must not read it as a failed payment; it is unresolved until the chain is asked.
